products.name: Govee WiFi Water Sensor 3 Pack (H5040)
products.query: Govee WiFi Water Sensor 3 Pack H5040 water leak detector
products.summary: A plug-in gateway plus three small battery sensors that sound a 100 dB alarm and push phone alerts. It suits a renter who wants cheap coverage for the sink, washer and water heater without a subscription.
products.renterNote: Sensors sit loose on the floor and the gateway plugs into an outlet, so nothing is stuck or drilled. Caveat: the gateway joins 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only, not 5 GHz, so check your router.
pros: Gateway handles up to 10 sensors, and listings describe a 100 dB alarm you can silence from the app
Sealed sensors are rated for splashes and submersion (listings say IP66 or IP67)
Three sensors cover the usual trouble spots in one box
cons: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; pairing can be fiddly on dual-band routers
Gateway uses an outlet, and owners report a low-battery chirp that is hard to silence

specs.Connectivity: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi gateway, 433 MHz link to sensors
specs.Power: Gateway plugs in; sensors use batteries

products.scoreNote: Loose sensors and a plug-in gateway leave no marks and pack up on move-out; value is strong but it is 2.4 GHz only with limited smart home reach.

praise: Easy setup and quick text/email alerts when tested
Good value for a multi-sensor pack
complaints: No local Home Assistant integration, and a persistent low-battery chirp reported

products.name: YoLink Water Leak Sensor 1 Kit (4 sensors + hub)
products.query: YoLink Water Leak Sensor 1 Kit 4-Pack Hub YS7903 LoRa
products.badge: Best for big or thick-walled apartments
products.summary: A hub plus four Water Leak Sensor 1 units that talk over long-range LoRa instead of Wi-Fi. It suits a renter with a basement unit, a far-off laundry room or weak Wi-Fi under the sink.
products.renterNote: Sensors sit loose and the hub plugs in, so it leaves nothing behind. Caveat: it needs the YoLink hub on Ethernet or 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, and reviewers and owners describe app setup and automation linking as fiddly, so match the Water Leak Sensor 1 kit (YS7903).
pros: LoRa link reaches where Wi-Fi struggles (the hub is rated up to about a quarter mile in open air)
Owners on forums describe the sensors and hub as dependable
Works with the YoLink app and can grow to other YoLink devices, such as a valve controller
cons: Needs the hub and its own app, and reviewers call setup and automation linking cumbersome
Range figures differ between sources, so treat them as maximums

specs.Connectivity: LoRa to hub; hub on Ethernet or 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi
specs.Power: Replaceable batteries (battery life not confirmed by the sources seen)
specs.Hub range: Up to about 1/4 mile open air, per reviews

products.scoreNote: No adhesive or tools, great range; extra hub, fiddly setup and higher kit cost hold back value and install.

praise: Long LoRa range reaches basements and far rooms where other protocols struggle
Described as dependable ("rock solid") by forum owners
Reliable alerts, and valve shutoff when paired with a YoLink valve
complaints: Hub is required, and app setup and manual automation linking feel cumbersome
Sensors can drop offline or out of third-party integrations until re-paired or the hub is power-cycled
Sensors must be removed before mopping to avoid false triggers (valve-shutoff setups)

products.name: SwitchBot Water Leak Detector
products.query: SwitchBot Water Leak Detector WiFi Bluetooth
products.summary: A single small Wi-Fi sensor with a loud alarm and app alerts that needs no hub. It suits a renter who wants one cheap sensor under the sink or beside the washer.
products.renterNote: It sits loose on the floor on 2 AAA batteries, so there is nothing to remove. Caveat: it is one sensor per unit, and one tester reported missed push alerts on cellular.
pros: Connects straight to Wi-Fi with no hub, per SwitchBot's pages
IP67 housing and alarm around 80-100 dB depending on source
Works with Alexa, Google Assistant and IFTTT, and fits SwitchBot automations
cons: One tester found push alerts did not arrive away from home on cellular
Sources disagree on whether a Hub Mini is needed for voice and automations
products.scoreNote: Hub-free and loose-placement; compact enough to move, but single-sensor units add up and alert reliability reports are mixed.

complaints: Push notifications missed on cellular in one test
Alarm measured quieter than the 100 dB claim in one test (80 dB)

sources.title: Bob Vila: We Tested the Best Water Leak Detectors

products.name: Eve Water Guard
products.query: Eve Water Guard connected water leak detector HomeKit Thread
products.summary: A powered base with a 6.5 ft sensing cable that triggers a 100 dB alarm and HomeKit alerts. It suits a renter with an iPhone who wants to run a cable along a dishwasher, fridge line or water heater.
products.renterNote: It plugs into an outlet and the cable lies on the floor, so it leaves nothing behind. Caveat: Apple Home only (no Alexa, Google or SmartThings) and it needs a nearby outlet.
pros: Sensing cable catches water along its whole 6.5 ft length
Thread and Bluetooth with no bridge or cloud account
cons: Apple ecosystem only, and remote access/automations need a home hub

specs.Cable: 6.5 ft (2 m) sensing cable, extensions sold separately

products.scoreNote: Loose cable and plug-in base are fully reversible; Apple-only support, outlet needed and higher cost lower compatibility and value.

praise: Long sensing cable covers more floor than a spot sensor
Reliable HomeKit alerts with no cloud account
complaints: A small share of buyers report connection failures

products.name: Flo by Moen Smart Water Detector
products.query: Flo by Moen Smart Water Detector
products.matchName: Flo by Moen Smart Water Detector
products.summary: A Wi-Fi puck sensor that connects directly to your network, also reads temperature and humidity and sends alerts to phone and email. It suits a renter who wants one polished sensor and may never add Moen's shutoff.
products.renterNote: It sits on the floor and needs no hub; do not buy the Moen shutoff valve, which is plumbed in. Caveat: no Alexa, Google or HomeKit support, and Amazon availability and exact model number need a check before publishing.
pros: Wi-Fi without a hub, with temperature and humidity monitoring
Fast alerts to iOS, Android and email per Reviewed
Can pair with a Moen shutoff if you later own a home
cons: No smart assistant or IFTTT integration, per TechHive and Reviewed
Reviews of Moen's wider Flo line report false alarms and weak support
products.scoreNote: Loose placement and no hub, but pricey per sensor with no smart assistant support.

praise: Reliable leak detection once set up
Temperature and humidity readings are a bonus
complaints: Reports of dead batteries on arrival and unreliable false alarms in Moen's wider Flo line
